tagline: Exploit-aware patch prioritisation with an evidence-only assistant

event.name: in7.0thon (VVCE)
event.problem_statement: PS #17 Autonomous Vulnerability Intelligence & RAG Agent

focus: 1. Exploit-aware ranking with an explainable score, proven by a backtest vs CVSS-only
2. Evidence-only assistant: cited answers, deterministic citation verifier, refuses without evidence

stack.llm: ONE provider (Anthropic or Gemini), chosen by Person 3

rules: Contract changes (schema, function signatures, contracts.py, config weights) need an all-hands issue + PR
Open PR into main early and often; keep tests green
No new dependency without telling the team

scoring.ordering: Tier first (Critical..Low), then score descending. KEV items are always Critical but still sorted by score inside the tier.
scoring.asset_factor: max criticality of matched assets; 0.5 neutral if no inventory loaded; 0.0 if inventory exists but CVE matches nothing

data_sources.epss: https://www.first.org/epss/data_stats lists current + dated daily files; VERIFY the download URL first thing
data_sources.nvd_window: sync supports published 2024-01-01 .. 2025-12-31; snapshot defaults to 2025-10-01 .. 2025-12-31 to stay under 50 MB
data_sources.fix_links: NVD reference URLs tagged 'Patch' or 'Vendor Advisory'

functions.scoring.ranked_queue(conn, only_matched=: columns: rank, cve_id, tier, score, cvss, epss, kev, asset_crit, matched_assets, description
functions.scoring.explain(conn, cve_id) -> dict: {cve_id, score, tier, kev_override, matched_assets[], components[{factor, raw, normalized, weight, contribution}]}
functions.assistant.retrieve(conn, question) -> li: Evidence(id, cve_id, kind, text, source); id like 'CVE-2099-0002:kev'
functions.assistant.verify_citations(answer, evide: cited ids subset of retrieved; CVE ids in text subset of evidence
functions.ingest.new_kev_since_last_sync(conn) ->: KEV ids not yet in kev_seen
functions.ingest.simulate_new_kev(conn) -> str: offline demo: inserts CVE-2099-0010 into KEV

fixture.note: SYNTHETIC. CVE-2099-* do not exist. Everyone develops against this until P1 ships the real snapshot.

worked_example.CVE-2099-0010: demo CVE: becomes #1 when simulated KEV fires

must: Ranked queue + factor breakdown in UI
Backtest chart + table reproducible by one command
Assistant answers with verified citations and refuses correctly; eval numbers recorded
should: Asset CSV upload with fuzzy match + review

demo_script: CVSS-only order vs PatchPilot order, explain with factor bars
Assistant answers a real question with citations
Click 'Check for new KEV': CVE jumps to #1
